description.value: Princeton Pub is a neighbourhood pub located in East Vancouver at 1901 Dundas Street. It operates as a traditional pub-style venue in a mixed residential and commercial area of the city. Touring cyclists passing through East Vancouver may find it a convenient stop for a meal or drink.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is not usable: princetonpub.com appears to have expired or been hijacked and now redirects to a suspicious third-party URL (resultfindernow.com), blocked as a security threat.
